Dear [Canon Warburton ](/person/1466)
I send you a spare proof of your final story in case you should like to have it apart from its adjuncts of the Christmas number[^1]
Yours very sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: It is not easy to identify which Christmas number Warburton contributed to.
